camel_example: aliyun rtc CreateAppAgentTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --AppId 'ac7N****' --Name '智能体模版' --version 2018-01-11 --method POST --force
kebab_example: aliyun rtc create-app-agent-template --app-id 'ac7N****' --name '智能体模版' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAppAgentTemplate

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The agent type. Valid values:
1: Voice call (default)
parameters.help_zh:
智能体类型：
1: 语音通话（默认）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The conversation mode. Valid values:
1: Natural conversation mode (default).
2: Walkie-talkie mode
parameters.help_zh:
对话模式：
1: 自然对话模式（默认）
2: 对讲机模式
parameters.name: chat_mode

parameters.help_en:
The interruption mode. Valid values:
1: Interruption allowed (default).
2: Interruption disabled
parameters.help_zh:
打断方式：
1: 支持打断（默认）
2: 禁止打断
parameters.name: interrupt_mode

parameters.help_en: The greeting message. The maximum length is 500 characters
parameters.help_zh: 问候语，最大长度不超过500
parameters.name: greeting

fields.help_en: The sentence silence detection threshold. Default value: 500 ms. Valid values: 200 to 6000
fields.help_zh: 语音断句检测阈值，默认500ms，允许范围[200，6000]
fields.name: max_sentence_silence

fields.help_en: The name
fields.help_zh: 名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The minimum duration of continuous voice signals in milliseconds to avoid false interruptions. Default value: 300. Valid values: 0 to 3000
fields.help_zh: 人声持续阈值 (ms)，取值范围为[0,3000]。持续检测到人声信号的最小时间长度，避免误打断。默认300ms
fields.name: interrupt_speech_duration

fields.help_en: The voice activity detection (VAD) configuration
fields.help_zh: vad配置
fields.name: vad_config

fields.help_en:
The language code. This parameter is optional. The large language model automatically identifies the language. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
fields.help_zh:
语言代码。可不写，大模型会自动设别。
zh: 中文
en: 英文
fields.name: lang

fields.help_en: The hot word weight. Valid values: integers from 1 to 5. Common value: 4. If the effect is not obvious, you can increase the weight. However, a large weight may cause negative effects and lead to inaccurate recognition of other words
fields.help_zh:
热词权重，取值范围为[1, 5]之间的整数。
常用值：4。
如果效果不明显可以适当增加权重，但是当权重较大时可能会引起负面效果，导致其他词语识别不准确
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en: The hot word text. Each word can be up to 10 Chinese characters or English words in length
fields.help_zh: 热词文本，每个词语最长10个汉字或英文单词
fields.name: word

fields.help_en: The hot words. Each vocabulary can contain up to 500 hot words, and each hot word can be up to 10 Chinese characters in length. Hot words must be UTF-8 encoded and cannot contain punctuation marks or special characters. Otherwise, the hot words do not take effect
fields.help_zh:
每个词表最多包含500个热词，每个热词中文长度不超过10个字符。
热词必须为UTF-8编码，不能包含标点、特殊字符，不符合的情况下，无热词效果
fields.name: word_weights

fields.help_en: The ID of the Model Studio agent
fields.help_zh: 百炼智能体ID
fields.name: agent_app_id

fields.help_en: The API key required by the large language model service provider
fields.help_zh: 大模型服务商需要的apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en: The number of historical conversation turns provided to the large language model. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 50
fields.help_zh: 给大模型提供多少历史对话轮次，最大100，默认值50
fields.name: history_depth

fields.help_en: The maximum number of tokens for the output text. Default value: 8192
fields.help_zh: 输出文本的最大限制，默认值8192
fields.name: max_token

fields.help_en: The name
fields.help_zh: 名称
fields.name: name

fields.example: 你是一个高级心理医生。
fields.help_en: The prompt for the large language model. The maximum length is 5,000 characters
fields.help_zh: 大模型提示词，最大长度为5000
fields.name: prompt

fields.help_en: The sampling temperature. Default value: 0.7. Valid values: [0, 2)
fields.help_zh: 采样温度，取值范围[0,2)，默认值0.7
fields.name: temperature

fields.help_en: The top-P sampling range. Default value: 0.8. Valid values: (0, 1]
fields.help_zh: 采样的选择范围(0,1]，默认值0.8
fields.name: topp

fields.help_en: The endpoint URL for connecting to a third-party large language model
fields.help_zh: 接入第三方大模型时，该字段表示接入的endpoint
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The provider. Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and third-party configurations that comply with OpenAI API specifications are supported
fields.help_zh: 提供方，目前支持阿里云-百炼和第三方配置（符合OpenAI接口规范）
fields.name: vendor

fields.help_en: The API key required by the large language model service provider
fields.help_zh: 大模型服务商需要的apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en:
The filter settings. Valid values:
1: Chinese parentheses （）
2: English parentheses ()
3: Chinese square brackets 【】
4: English square brackets []
5: English curly braces {}
fields.help_zh:
过滤设置。
1-中文刮号（）
2-英文刮号()
3-中文方刮号【】
4-英文方刮号[]
5-英文花刮号{}
fields.name: filter_brackets

fields.help_en: The name
fields.help_zh: 名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The pitch. Default value: 1.0. Valid values: 0.5 to 2.0
fields.name: pitch

fields.help_en: The speech rate. Default value: 1.0. Valid values: 0.5 to 2.0
fields.name: rate

fields.help_en: The provider. Alibaba Cloud Model Studio is supported
fields.help_zh: 提供方，目前支持阿里云-百炼
fields.name: vendor

longwan

fields.help_en: The volume. Default value: 50. Valid values: 0 to 100
fields.help_zh: 音量，取值范围[0~100]，默认50
fields.name: volume

fields.help_en: The timeout period for silence alerts, in seconds. This alert can be triggered multiple times. If the agent remains silent after the timeout period elapses, the alert is triggered again upon the next timeout. Valid values: 5 to 600. Default value: 0. A value of 0 indicates that no alert is triggered
fields.help_zh:
静默提醒的超时时间（单位：秒）。
可能多次触发，若智能体静默提醒超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发，取值范围：[5, 600]，默认值0，0表示不提醒
fields.name: alert_timeout

fields.help_en: The content of the silence prompt message
fields.help_zh: 静默提示消息的内容
fields.name: content

fields.help_en:
The handling strategy for silence timeout. Valid values:
1: Broadcasts the prompt message specified by Content to the user via voice.
2: Sends the prompt message specified by Content and the conversation history to the LLM, and broadcasts the reply generated by the model.
Default value: 1
fields.help_zh:
静默超时处理策略。
1 - 向用户语音播报content指定的提示消息
2 - 把content指定的提示消息和历史对话发送给LLM，并播报模型生成的回复
默认值：1
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en: The timeout period for triggering the webhook upon agent silence, in seconds. This webhook can be triggered multiple times. If the agent remains silent after the webhook timeout period elapses, the webhook is triggered again upon the next timeout. Valid values: 10 to 600. Default value: 0. A value of 0 indicates that the webhook is not triggered
fields.help_zh: 触发智能体静默超时webhook的静默超时时间（单位：秒）。可能多次触发，若智能体webhook静默超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发，取值范围：[10, 600]，默认值0，0表示不触发
fields.name: webhook_trigger_timeout

fields.help_en:
The default ambient sounds provided by the agent. Valid values:
white_noise 
office
fields.help_zh:
agent提供以下默认环境音：
    - white_noise 
    - office
fields.name: sound_id

fields.help_en: The volume level
fields.help_zh: 音量大小
fields.name: volume

parameters.help_en: The ambient environment configuration for the agent. If this parameter is not specified, the ambient environment configuration is not used
parameters.help_zh: 智能体环境音配置。不传表示不使用环境配置
parameters.name: ambient_sound_config

fields.help_en: The semantic interruption configuration
fields.help_zh: 按语义打断
fields.name: semantics_interrupt

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable backchanneling
fields.help_zh: 是否开启承接词
fields.name: user_turn_end

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable video understanding. If enabled, the LLM must support multimodal data
parameters.help_zh: 如果开启，LLM模型必须支持多模态数据
parameters.name: enable_video_understanding

parameters.help_en:
The preferred video stream for the agent to process when visual understanding is enabled. The agent can process only one video stream at a time. When both the camera stream and the screen sharing stream are pushed simultaneously, this parameter specifies the preferred stream. Valid values:
1: The agent preferentially processes the camera stream.
2: The agent preferentially processes the screen sharing stream.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
开启视觉理解后，可以设置智能体优先理解的视频流。
智能体只能理解一路视频流，当Camera流和屏幕共享流同时推流

1 - 智能体优先理解Camera流；

2 - 智能体优先理解屏幕共享流；

默认优先理解Camera流
parameters.name: prefer_video
